topic: Mertens's Conjecture 3 for periodic one-dimensional range-two stable partial matchings
title: Mertens's range-two stable-matching conjecture and fully supported preference laws

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: For Mertens's Conjecture 3 in Random stable matchings (Section 3.2, equation (15), page 7; arXiv:cond-mat/0509221v2), we prove p_N=Theta(q^N) for the one-dimensional range-two model, simultaneously for both parities, by a six-site completion of open preference words. Here p_N is the probability of a stable partial matching, and q is in (0,1). The same construction proves this conclusion for every fully supported independent identically distributed law on the 24 local rankings. For the uniform law it gives explicit finite-size bounds and convergent enclosures for q. We also give the elementary range-one comparison and triangle-packing bounds, and explain the complete-graph endpoint of Conjecture 5 using Young and Studebaker's corrected asymptotic constant.
summary: Six-site completion proves common-base decay for range-two cycles under uniform or fully supported iid rankings, with effective base enclosures and precisely scoped neighboring results.
